name: PlayStagedBank

name: SilenceVolumeChannel2
evidence: SetVolumeChannelFactor(2, 1, 0.0); RestoreVolumeChannel2 sets it back to 1.0

name: PauseStagedBankVoice
evidence: sends g_stagedBankVoice IOP command 0x13 (func_0011D640); SetPauseMenuOpen and SetWarpMenuOpen call it as they open

name: ResumeStagedBankVoice
evidence: sends g_stagedBankVoice IOP command 0x14 (func_0011D670); SetPauseMenuOpen and SetWarpMenuOpen call it as they close

name: AllocateSoundLevelEntry

name: RemoveSoundLevelEntry

evidence: walks the list at world+0x1BC4 removing every entry, then applies 0x14 with func_0011D928 and zeroes D_002748EC, D_00274738 and D_00274734

name: PushSoundLevel
evidence: allocates an entry with func_001BED98, stores the argument clamped to -20..0x6B in it and raises the current level D_00274734 to it (keeping the old in D_00274738) when it is higher or the list was empty

name: RecomputeSoundLevel
evidence: sets D_00274734 to 0 when the list at world+0x1BC4 is empty, else to the maximum value (first word) of its entries, starting from -20

name: ReleaseSoundLevel
evidence: removes the entry and, when its value was the current level D_00274734, recomputes the level, clears D_002748EC when non-negative, applies cur+0x14 with func_0011D928 and issues func_001C06A0(7,1,1.0)

name: RemoveSoundLevelAndRecompute
evidence: removes the entry and, when its value was the current level, stores it in D_00274738 and recomputes with func_001BEF88 (no apply, unlike func_001BF048)

name: InitSoundSystem
evidence: clears D_00604790 (0x1C bytes of bank handles), calls func_0011CBB8 (InitIopCommandChannels), loads bank 0 with func_001BE268, enables disc access with func_0011DF58 and issues the fixed func_0011D520, func_0011D558 and func_0011E3A0 set-up calls

name: IsSoundEmitterUpdateDisabled
evidence: returns the word D_00274748 (never written but its initial 0); UpdateSoundEmitters returns at once when it is nonzero

name: ComputeSoundVolumeAndPan
evidence: from a position's distance to the camera (+0x40) between the inner and outer ranges gives the volume (full inside, none beyond) and the pan from its direction along the camera's side axis (+0x90); ComputeSoundAttenuation and UpdateSoundEmitters call it

name: MeasureCameraWeightedDistance
evidence: the listener function ChooseSoundListenerFunction picks for one or two camera controllers: the distance between two points with the part along the camera's axis (+0x80) shrunk by the factor at +0x478

name: MeasureListenerDistance
evidence: the listener function ChooseSoundListenerFunction picks by default: the plain distance between two points

name: GetSoundListenerPosition
evidence: returns the +0x140 position of the active switched collider (func_001925F0) when its slot 78 says so, else the vector at D_00261990+0x40

name: ComputeSoundRecordDoppler
evidence: for a record with a source object (+0x30) and a factor (+0x5C) stores at +0x60 a pitch offset (func_0011E538) from the two bodies' velocities (func_001278A8) along the line from the source to the active switched collider; clears it otherwise

name: ChooseSoundListenerFunction
evidence: returns func_001BF398 or func_001BF2E0 depending on a count read by func_00149638 from the structure at D_00261990+0x460 (1 or 2 picks func_001BF2E0)

name: ComputeSoundListenerFactor
evidence: fetches the listener position (func_001BF3D0) and calls through the function pointer func_001BF578 chooses with it and the argument, returning a float

name: ComputeSoundAttenuation
evidence: with a position computes a factor with func_001BF5E0 and hands it to func_001BF200 together with the output volume and flag; without a position writes the default volume and 0

name: AllocateSoundRecord
evidence: pops a record from the free list at world+0x1BA0 (func_001B5EA0), zeroes its 0x90 bytes and appends it to the active list at world+0x1BAC

name: ClearSoundRecordHandle
evidence: clears the back-pointer field (+0xC) of the record the slot points to and then the slot itself

name: FreeSoundRecord
evidence: clears the caller's handle word, sets the record id to -1, removes it from the active list world+0x1BAC and returns it to the free list world+0x1BA0

name: StopSoundRecord
evidence: with n == 0 stops the voice at +0x18 (func_0011D600), otherwise starts a fade of the voice scaled by n*0.24 (func_0011D860); then frees the record with func_001BF728

name: SetSoundRecordPitch
evidence: stores the float at +0x58, computes base + f58*1524 + offset clamped to -0x8000..0x7FFF and passes it to func_0011D810 (SetVoicePitch) for the record's voice

name: SetSoundRecordVolume
evidence: stores the new base volume at +0x14, scales the attenuated volume at +0x50 by the same ratio and re-applies it with func_001BE860

name: InitSoundRecord
evidence: clears a 0x90-byte record keeping +0x64, links it to its parent handle, stores the unique id from D_0027474C, the ranges, volume, pitch and random byte (func_001EAA70), copies the position and calls func_001BF620 for the attenuated volume and pan

name: StartSoundRecordVoice
evidence: after a record is built: stores the entry index and bank handle, starts a voice with func_0011D598 (func_001BE4A8 handle, entry word b) when its volume is nonzero and its delay negative, then applies pitch (func_001BF7F8) and volume/pan (func_001BE860); id -2 uses the stream voice D_0027472C

name: ScheduleAmbientSoundRecord
evidence: sets the record's next start (+0x74) to the clock plus a random delay between +0x78 and +0x7C and, without a source object, places it at a random angle and a distance between +0x80 and +0x84 around the listener (GetSoundListenerPosition)

name: StartSoundEffect
evidence: starts a sound by entry index into D_00245020: skips it when the entry's bank is nonzero and differs from the world's +0x1D70, builds and links a tracked record (func_001BF6B8, func_001BF920) when a handle or position is given, otherwise starts an untracked voice with func_0011D598

name: MarkSoundRecordIfIdMatches
evidence: callback taking a record pointer and an id packed in a 64-bit key: when guard is 0 and the record's id (+4) still equals the id, sets the record's flag at +0x48 to 1

name: SetVolumeChannel6Factors
evidence: sets factors 0, 2 and 3 of volume channel 6 to the value, and factor 1 too when the flag is set

name: UpdateSoundEmitters
evidence: walks the world's emitter list, stops or restarts each entry's voice (func_0011D600 / func_0011D598) by its distance to the listener against its range, sets its volume and pan, and steps a music level ramp D_00274738 toward its target

name: SetIopVolumeChannel8
evidence: sends volume channel 8 to the IOP as the value times 1024 (SetIopVolumeChannel)

name: ApplyVolumeChannelFactors
evidence: multiplies the 11 factors of one column of D_00274838, clamps the product to 0..1 and passes it times 1024 to SetIopVolumeChannel for that column

name: SetVolumeChannelFactor
evidence: stores a float at [row][column] of D_00274838 and re-applies that column with ApplyVolumeChannelFactors

name: ResetVolumeChannelFactors
evidence: copies the default table D_00274758 over D_00274838 (0xB0 bytes), sets channel 8 to full and re-applies columns 0..3

name: SilenceVolumeChannel3
evidence: sets factor 1 of volume channel 3 to 0.0 when the flag is set and to 1.0 otherwise

name: ApplySoundOptionFlag
evidence: passes whether its argument is nonzero to SetIopSoundOptionFlag; ResetVolumeChannelFactors, ResumeAtSavedLevel and ActivatePauseMenuSelection call it with the save data's option bit 0x40

name: StopAllSoundsAndWait
evidence: stops the world's sound records, ClearSoundLevels, ClearCachedVoiceParams, then polls the IOP commands until none are left and syncs the disc read

name: StopWorldSoundRecords
evidence: walks the world's list at +0x1BAC calling StopSoundRecord on each object with item, then PollIopCommands

name: PushIopChannel2Setting
evidence: while fewer than 4 pairs are stacked, applies a setting to IOP channel 2 (func_0011E328/func_0011E360) and pushes the pair on the stack at +0x2328

name: PopIopChannel2Setting
evidence: drops the top pair of the stack at +0x2328 (keeping one) and re-applies the pair below it to IOP channel 2

name: SetIopChannel2Setting
evidence: applies a setting to IOP channel 2 and stores the pair at +0x2328 with the flag at +0x2348 set

name: AddWorldSoundEntry
evidence: appends a key with two constant 8-byte values to the world's array of up to 16 entries at +0x1D84 (count at +0x1D80)

name: SetLastWorldSoundEntryFromPoint
evidence: sets the two values of the world's last sound entry (+0x1D84, count at +0x1D80) to 8000 - 50 y and 8000 - 50 x of the point

name: SetLastWorldSoundEntryValues
evidence: copies an 8-byte pair into the world's last sound entry at its offset 4 (AddWorldSoundEntry appends the entries)

name: StartWorldSoundEntries
evidence: calls StartSoundEffect once per entry of the array at +0x1D84 with the entry's key and its two stored 8-byte values

name: SetCachedVoiceParam
